incident.name: Equifax Data Breach
incident.description: Unpatched Apache Struts vulnerability exposed PII of 147M Americans including SSNs, DOBs, and credit card numbers.
incident.root_cause: Unpatched known vulnerability (2 months old), poor asset inventory
incident.lessons: Patch management and asset inventory are foundational security controls.

relatedIncidents.name: Lazarus Group Bangladesh Bank Heist
relatedIncidents.description: $81M stolen from Bangladesh Bank via fraudulent SWIFT messages. $951M attempted. Exploited weak SWIFT security controls.
relatedIncidents.root_cause: Weak SWIFT security controls, no anomaly detection on transactions
relatedIncidents.lessons: Financial transaction monitoring and SWIFT security controls are critical.

relatedIncidents.name: Bybit Crypto Heist
relatedIncidents.description: Lazarus Group compromised the Safe{Wallet} multisig interface used by Bybit, injecting malicious JavaScript to redirect a $1.5B ETH transfer. Largest crypto theft in history.
relatedIncidents.root_cause: Supply chain compromise of third-party wallet UI, insufficient transaction verification
relatedIncidents.lessons: Crypto platforms must verify transaction destinations out-of-band. Third-party UI dependencies are critical attack surfaces.

relatedIncidents.name: LexisNexis Data Breach
relatedIncidents.description: FulcrumSec exploited known React2Shell vulnerability in unpatched LexisNexis frontend, pivoted via over-permissioned IAM roles into AWS Secrets Manager containing 53 plaintext credentials. 3.9M records exfiltrated including data on 118 federal judges and DOJ attorneys.
relatedIncidents.root_cause: Unpatched known vulnerability, over-permissioned IAM roles, secrets stored in plaintext
relatedIncidents.lessons: Known vulnerabilities must be patched immediately. IAM roles must follow least privilege. Secrets must never be stored in plaintext.
